description: Catalog of recurring service billers (agua, electricidad, internet, renta, etc.) used to categorize POS GMO 'Servicios' expenses — distinct from Suppliers, which are goods vendors (e.g. Sam's Club).

fields.name: serviceName
fields.description: Display name, e.g. "CFE - Electricidad", "OOMAPAS - Agua", "Telmex - Internet"

fields.name: category
fields.description: One of: agua | electricidad | internet | renta | otro

fields.name: active
fields.description: 1 = active, 0 = inactive — matches existing POS GMO convention (see dbo.Suppliers.active)
